description: Book a transaction to a chart-of-accounts account by its full path (e.g. "expenses/software-and-subscriptions", "revenue/sales-revenue"). This is the account the amount posts to, so prefer it over transaction_categorize_transaction. Writes a user override that AI enrichment never overwrites, and the bookkeeping journal entry re-derives from the account. List valid paths with accounting_get_chart_of_accounts.
name: transaction_categorize_transaction_by_account
title: Categorize Transaction By Account
